dogecoin.text: Someone today wanted to clearly show a middle finger to @elonmusk everytime he mentioned #dogecoin to break the positive perception & the patterns which established themselves over the past months by causing panic. (6/8)

@elonmusk understood this disruptive power very soon and saw & still sees in #dogecoin thanks to it’s low entry barrier, but high market cap a unique opportunity to support the broad masses of our society. (3/8)
